author: Kai Moreno
title: Regional capacity watch (not an incident)
content:
# Purpose
Capacity watch is an internal note that a region is near a queue limit. It is not a customer incident and we do not post a public banner for a watch.

# When to use
Engineering posted a watch in #capacity. A customer asks why a single model is slower. If only a subset of requests is slow and the rest succeed, this may be a watch, not a listed outage.

# Priority and routing
A watch with customers still succeeding is P2, Support, no escalated unless the severity matrix says otherwise. Do not treat a watch as 'already posted on the public banner'.

# What Support says
We are watching capacity in that region. There is no banner because the region is not in incident. We will update if we post one.

# Related
Capacity on-call. Do not confuse with the already-posted incidents page.
